title: Video Scanner Accuracy & Floating Icon Recognition
summary: Eliminates spurious weapon false positives from inventory detail sheets, resolves alignment for vertically shifted materials (like Sakura Bloom), and guarantees material isolation in video scans.

changes.text: Inventory detail sheet rejection: constrained detector aspect ratio and rejected single-column card grids, eliminating spurious weapon matches (such as Kagotsurube Isshin) and missing thumbnail 404 errors when tapping items during recordings.

Floating material icon recognition: introduced coarse vertical shift evaluation and expanded alignment search limits for materials with floating artwork (such as Sakura Bloom), achieving 100% recognition confidence on both full and downscaled frames.
Quantity reading alignment fallback: footer digit OCR now falls back to canonical card box alignment when icon artwork shifts, guaranteeing reliable counts for materials with floating particles.
Strict material merger filtering: guarded SightingMerger against non-material cards, ensuring video scan material tallies are completely isolated from equipment.
